rca of the issue: Root cause: /confirmacao.html originally missing the DOM-fill script that reads sessionStorage 'inscricao_dados' and writes textContent to c-* spans. Fix: added <script id=conf-fill> that parses the JSON on DOMContentLoaded, maps SEXO codes ('0'->MASCULINO, '1'->FEMININO), joins DOC_FRENTE_NAME/DOC_VERSO_NAME into c-arquivos, maps booleans (cotas_negros, PORTADOR_DEFICIENCIA, atendimento_especial) to Sim/Não, and uses POLO_TRABALHO/INSTITUICAO_UF/INSTITUICAO_CIDADE for the Instituição Associada block. Verified end-to-end via sessionStorage seed + reload.
